items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Shortly after that Alice went back to the United States.

ctx.x: Shortly after that Alice went back to the United States. By this time, though, everyone's pretty well gone. Phil Woods stands up and says, "I'd like to make a speech." And he gets -- the alto player, Jerry Dodgion, he says, "Translate, motherfucker." So Jerry Dodgion goes (Unintelligible). So Phil goes on and he's harranguing and he says, "translate, Motherfucker." And then Phil starts talking double talk and the guy from the Embassy's trying to pull him down. And Phil says, "All right, you don't want me to…
on the Russians. I told them, boy, you know, anyone who drinks 32 toasts in a row has seen a drunk before. I said, don't worry about it.
